summary: Savings formulas: manual cost per template = manual time per host × total hosts across runs × cost per hour; automation cost per template = automation cost per hour × total elapsed hours; savings = sum of (manual − automation cost) across templates.
questions: What formula does the automation calculator use?
How is manual cost per template calculated?

answer_card.title: Automation savings formulas
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Manual cost per template** = time for a manual run on one host × sum of hosts across job runs × cost per hour
- **Automation cost per template** = automation cost per hour × total elapsed hours for the template
- **Savings** = Σ (manual cost − automation cost) across all templates
